$comment: CURATED DEMO DATA. Every field in every profile below is illustrative and hand-authored for the Sift demo. None of it is measured, sourced from a manufacturer, or verified. The bundled EPA-derived catalog (vehicle-catalog.json, 853 records) is the real discovery universe and carries make/model/year/trim, body style, drivetrain, powertrain, fuel economy, annual fuel cost, emissions and range; it does NOT carry cargo dimensions, child-seat layout, safety or reliability ratings, ownership cost, or any price. Those are exactly the fields a person actually decides on, so this file supplies them for a stable cohort of eight models and labels every one of them `curated_demo` so the product can say so on screen. Nothing here is a dealer listing: there is no local availability, no current price, and no specific vehicle. `indicativePriceBandUsd` is a rough national band for a model at a trim level, never a quote.
disclosure: Curated demo data: dimensions, ratings, and cost figures are illustrative and are not measured, sourced, or current.
